name: Refactor VibeCodingView layout
description:
Here's a 5-line summary of the conversation:

1. The user had overflow issues with branch `<select>` elements in `VibeCodingHeader.vue`.
2. The fix involved setting fixed widths (`w-[110px] max-w-[110px]`) on both select elements instead of just `max-w-[130px]`.
3. `text-ellipsis` was added to the selects to truncate overflowing branch names with `...`.
4. `:title="b"` was added to `<option>` elements so users can hover to see the full branch name.
5. `min-w-0` and `shrink-0` were applied to flex containers and buttons to ensure proper truncation and layout stability.

# Refactored VibeCodingView - Simplified Layout I'll refactor the VibeCodingView to remove the changes section and add git controls to the header, allowing PR review mode in the chat itself. ```vue client/src/views/VibeCodingView.vue ``` Now create the BranchSelector component: ```vue client/src/components/git/BranchSelector.vue ``` ## Key Changes: 1. **Removed changes section** - No longer shows diff view in a separate panel 2. **Branch selector in header** - Quick branch switching with dropdown 3. **Create branch modal** - Add new branches directly from header 4. **PR review toggle** - Chat can switch to `prview` mode to show PR changes 5. **Simplified layout** - Only Chat and Preview panels with dynamic sizing 6. **Git controls** - All git operations (branch switch, create branch) in the header status bar 7. **Cleaner structure** - Removed diff-related data and methods, consolidated functionality The chat component now handles PR review mode natively through its mode switching, so users can toggle between vibe and pr review modes within the same chat session.
Add a "changes" option in the header with chat and preview that will show a PRView  column from current chat

I'll help you add a "changes" option in the header that shows a PRView column from the current chat. Let me analyze the current structure and implement this feature. ```vue client/src/views/VibeCodingView.vue ``` ## Key Changes: 1. **Added Changes Button**: New button in the header toggle group with warning color (`btn-warning`) and code-compare icon 2. **PR View Panel**: Middle column that displays `PRView` component showing git changes 3. **Dynamic Width Calculations**: - `chatWidth` and `changesWidth` computed properties handle responsive layout for 2 or 3 column layouts 4. **New Data Properties**: - `showChanges`: Toggle for changes panel visibility - `fromBranch`: Tracks the "from" branch for comparisons 5. **View Toggle Method**: `toggleView()` simplifies managing visibility of chat, changes, and preview panels 6. **PR View Integration**: - Passes `fromBranch` and `currentBranch` to PRView - Handles branch selection changes - Forwards PR events (comment, column change, new chat) 7. **Refresh Method**: `refreshChanges()` to reload changes without full workspace reload The changes panel will show a side-by-side view of the repository changes when toggled on, with the ability to manage file columns and create related tasks directly from the changes view.
